title: mq.hybrid-retrieval-fixture.v1
description: Operator-authored relevance ground truth for one hybrid retrieval case. This is the only input in the evidence chain a human writes by hand, so its shape is validated before any measurement reads it: a misspelled key such as `expected` used to be ignored, leaving expected_refs empty and the case reporting no recall rather than failing. The namespace:reference form of each entry is enforced at load time rather than here, matching how sibling schemas constrain refs.

expected_refs.description: References a correct answer should retrieve.

contradicted_refs.description: References that contradict a correct answer.

stale_refs.description: References that are relevant but out of date.
